channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kevin Pritchard | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kevin Pritchard from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Todd Ramasar on Kevin Pritchard, Chad Buchanan, Donnie Walsh, Larry Bird
item.description:
Ramasar:

“He’s excited. There are a lot of memories up in Toronto, and a lot of good memories. Although things have changed to where he’s been moved, he’s ecstatic about the opportunity ahead of him in Indiana. First of all, it’s a first-class organization. When you look at [President] Kevin Pritchard and [general manager] Chad Buchanan, these are basketball guys with an organization that always has had basketball executives from Larry Bird to Donnie Walsh that have been there. Their front office is first class.”

Todd Ramasar on Kevin Pritchard, Chad Buchanan, Donnie Walsh, Larry Bird, Jan 18, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Kevin Pritchard
item.description:
Pacers coach Rick Carlisle on President Kevin Pritchard sprinting from courtside seat to join dogpile after buzzer-beating win over Lakers:

“You mean Jim Valvano? That’s what it looked like. He looked like Jimmy V. … This is a joyous group.”

Rick Carlisle on Kevin Pritchard, Nov 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Happy Walters on Kevin Pritchard
item.description:
“Kevin (Pritchard) I’ve known forever and (general manger) Chad (Buchanan) too. They’re two of the best guys with no egos and that’s Indiana people in general.“The front office is small and they’re very collaborative. So I’m just here to learn and to help where I can — just from the agent side and 15 years of doing that and looking at things in a different way. But these guys are the experts. I’m just really here to help when they need it and learn the other side of the business.”

Happy Walters on Kevin Pritchard, Jun 8, 2022. Source: Fieldhouse Files.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Kevin Pritchard, Herb Simon
item.description:
“My sincere thanks to Herb Simon, Kevin Pritchard and the entire Pacers organization for the opportunity to come back to basketball's heartland,”

Rick Carlisle on Kevin Pritchard, Herb Simon, Jun 24, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Herb Simon on Kevin Pritchard
item.description:
Simon said about the Hornets.

“I know they made some calls and we would have to (figure out) how he fits back into the team. Those are all basketball decisions and Larry and Kevin (Pritchard) are the best to answer that.”

Herb Simon on Kevin Pritchard, Dec 16, 2014. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Bill Bayno on Kevin Pritchard
item.description:
Joan Nielsen:Bayno:

“I called Kevin Pritchard… and said, ‘Look, this kid is really special. I think he’s a first-round pick, and I think he’s our guy.'”

Bill Bayno on Kevin Pritchard, Aug 1, 2012. Source: Twitter.
